item.title: Findi to Seek Shareholder Approval for $72m Strategic Investment by Nova Global Opportunities Fund
item.description: Findi to seek shareholder approval for up to $72m Nova Global investment to back India ATM rollout; initial $26m already arranged.

item.description: Besra Gold (ASX: BEZ) secures conditional renewal for Jugan deposit at Bau Gold Project, de-risking tenure; conditions pending and other renewals uncertain.

item.title: Metal Powder Works Secures UK Ministry of Defence Order, Bolstering NATO Network Position
item.description: Metal Powder Works lands UK MOD order, entering NATO defence network with DirectPowder titanium, boosting US-based production node and defence momentum.

item.title: Akora Resources Further Extends High-Grade Iron Ore Mineralisation at Bekisopa Project
item.description: AKORA Resources extends high-grade iron ore at Bekisopa; trench results lift DSO potential; resource update planned with Wardell Armstrong.

item.title: Wiseway Group Posts Robust 1H26 Results with 20% Revenue Surge and Profit Growth
item.description: Wiseway Group posts 1H26: revenue up 20% to $100.3m, PBT jumps 78%, US expansion fuels growth; interim dividend up 50% to 0.6c.

item.description: Comms Group hits record 1H FY26: revenue $37.6m, EBITDA $4.5m; TasmaNet integration boosts growth; FY26 guidance reaffirmed.

item.title: Dalaroo Metals Acquires Key Gold Project in Côte d'Ivoire
item.description: Dalaroo Metals clinches 80% Bondoukou Gold Project in Côte d’Ivoire; mining lease secured, funded by shares/options, expanding West Africa footprint.

item.title: Mithril Silver and Gold Identifies Priority Drill Targets Across Copalquin and La Dura Properties
item.description: Mithril identifies priority drill targets across Copalquin and La Dura after LiDAR and magnetic surveys; Phase IV drilling accelerates district exploration.

item.title: SciDev Navigates 1H FY26 Headwinds with Recurring Revenue Focus and Revised Guidance
item.description: SciDev 1H FY26: revenue down to $47.9m; pivots to recurring revenue, FY26 guidance raised to $100-$110m, with cost cuts and Rum Jungle upside.

item.title: Arika Resources Reports Strong Gold Assays from Ongoing Drilling at Yundamindra JV
